title: Qābiliyyat
transliterated_title: Qābiliyyat (On Receptivity; variant title Aʿmāl u Afʿāl)
genre: brief treatise / commentary on a Fuṣūṣ passage

date.basis: The entry gives no composition date and no copy in MS Majlis 10196; earliest dated copy listed is Rajab-Ramaḍān 842/January-March 1439 (MS 5423).

manuscript: Earliest listed: MS 5423 ff. 175b-77a, Fatih Collection, Süleymaniye Library, Istanbul (842/1439); 12 copies listed; none in MS Majlis 10196.
summary: A brief treatment of Ibn ʿArabī's teaching on the most holy emanation, centred on receptivity (qābiliyyat) and its bearing on predestination versus free will.
edition_note: Chahārdah Risāla-yi Fārsī (Tehran 1972) pp. 271-75; Persian, so readable by a player with the edition.
